body:
Answered 'proper SRE way to run Asterisk, gotta go on the IDUNA box, yolo install it?' -- yes to the plain Debian asterisk package + its own systemd unit, no to skipping security basics. Found a real :8088 conflict with the existing gpt2-alpine-c model server via ss -tulnp, fixed by disabling Asterisk's unused built-in HTTP/ARI server (this repo's PBX plan is AMI-only). AMI bound 127.0.0.1-only with a freshly generated secret; RTP firewall range narrowed 10000-20000 -> 10000-10099. Checked real headroom first (ss -tulnp, free -h, df -h). Queued as sudo-queue/50-install-asterisk-pbx.sh (root MONOREPO repo, commit 3042cd5) -- not yet run, needs real root. PARENA commit 81e2d87.

⚓ ☃
title: PBX-SRE-12442: real Asterisk install decision + queued sudo-queue script
